jobs_results.title: Localization QA Tester (Russian)
jobs_results.description:
Who We Are

2K is headquartered in Novato, California and is a wholly owned label of Take-Two Interactive Software, Inc. (NASDAQ: TTWO). Founded in 2005, 2K Games is a global video game company, publishing titles developed by some of the most influential game development studios in the world. Our studios responsible for developing 2K’s portfolio of world-class games across multiple platforms, include Visual Concepts, Firaxis, Hangar 13, CatDaddy, Cloud Chamber, 31st Union, and HB Studios. Our portfolio of titles is expanding due to our global strategic plan, building and acquiring exciting studios whose content continues to inspire all of us! 2K publishes titles in today’s most popular gaming genres, including sports, shooters, action, role-playing, strategy, casual, and family entertainment.

Our team of engineers, marketers, artists, writers, data scientists, producers, thinkers and doers, are the professional publishing stewards of our growing library of critically-acclaimed... franchises such as NBA 2K, 2K PGA, Battleborn, BioShock, Borderlands, The Quarry, The Darkness, Mafia, Sid Meier’s Civilization, Marvel’s Midnight Suns, WWE 2K, and XCOM.

At 2K, we pride ourselves on creating an inclusive work environment, which means encouraging our teams to Come as You Are and do your best work! We encourage ALL applicants to explore our global positions, even if they don’t meet every requirement for the role. If you're interested in the job and think you have what it takes to work at 2K, we encourage you to apply!

What We Need

We are looking for someone who can test video game titles on various consoles, PC’s and handhelds to ensure flawless game play by thoroughly checking the software for errors and entering them into the testing database. The Localization QA Tester reports to the Localization QA Lead and/or Associate Lead.

What You Will Do
• Find and report issues in the game, or through testing directly in the text database.
• Provide the correct translation, and where applicable fix directly via text database
• Provide context for foreign language defects
• Identify defects, follow test plans, and verify fixes
• Enter clear and concise bugs into bug tracking database
• Verify all printed materials related to software in test
• Work closely with other Localization QA team members

Who We Think Will Be A Great Fit
• Must be fluent, reading/writing, in Russian
• Must be able to communicate effectively in English, in both written and oral forms
• Technically proficient with PC’s, gaming consoles and related hardware
• Computer literacy, specifically with Windows, MS Word, Excel, Outlook, Google Suite and databases
• Well-developed interpersonal and communication skills
• Reliable with the ability to work in a team environment
• Attention to detail
• Passion for video games
• Be a positive role model, in terms of both work performance and attitude

Education and Experience:
• Bachelor diploma or equivalent
• Experience as a Localization QA Tester and/or Translator is a plus
• Preferable 0-2 years of QA experience

As an equal opportunity employer, we are committed to ensuring that qualified individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform their essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please contact us if you need reasonable accommodation.

Please note that 2K Games and its studios never uses instant messaging apps or personal email accounts to contact prospective employees or conduct interviews and when emailing, only use 2K.com accounts.

#LI-Onsite
#LI-LF1

jobs_results.title: QA Engineer - Mobile (Remote)
jobs_results.description:
Company Description

DHIS2 is a configurable platform for data collection and analysis -- free and open source self-hosted software and a proud Digital Public Good. Today it is used in more than 100 countries. This includes use by more than 70 national ministries of health where it serves as the backbone for country health information systems. It has been estimated that 2.4 billion people (30% of the world’s population) live in countries where DHIS2 is deployed.

We are a well-funded not-for-profit project located at the HISP Centre at the University of Oslo (UiO), where we operate as an independent software development organization. We work with and are supported by many global development organizations and are a World Health Organization collaborating center. DHIS2 is used every day around the world to manage routine health service delivery, COVID-19 surveillance and vaccination, Malaria elimination campaigns, HIV/AIDS prevention and treatment, Tuberculosis programs, maternal and... child health, national education systems, health supply chain logistics, climate impacts on human health, and much more.

With us you get a chance to work on problems which really matter: Improving the health and well-being of people around the world through access and use of information. We give you a lot of flexibility and freedom to make a difference while solving interesting technical challenges. At DHIS2 we believe you will do your best work if you fully understand the context in which the system operates, so you are encouraged to engage directly with our projects, take part in the design process, and get feedback from users in the field.

Job Description

We are looking for a QA mobile engineer to develop and execute exploratory and automated tests to ensure quality of mobile solutions to support data capture and management for Health Management Information Systems in several developing countries. We are working together with the department of informatics at the University of Oslo (UiO) on the design and development of the current generation of DHIS2 mobile applications in the context of national health systems in developing countries. Currently our team has 9 mobile developers and one of the main objectives of this position will be to design, implement, and conduct tests before product launches to identify and resolve system malfunctions to meet quality standards.

Main responsibilities
• Create detailed, comprehensive and well-structured test plans and test cases.
• Estimate, prioritise, plan and coordinate testing activities
• Design, develop, document, and run automation tests in espresso and compose.
• Identify, document clearly, verify and track bugs.
• Enhance overall quality and propose quality standards/tools
• Facilitate efficient development, test and release processes.
• Coordinate with the global DHIS2 QA team to align on principles and testing methodologies.
• Coordinate with developers to ensure best CI/CD practices.

Qualifications

Requirements
• Passionate about working on a meaningful, impactful, and challenging global project
• 3 - 5 years of work experience as a QA engineer for mobile solutions in highly scalable deployments.
• Excellent knowledge of testing frameworks such as Junit, Espresso, and Compose testing.
• Excellent knowledge of CI tools such as Jenkins or Bitrise.
• Experience with scripting languages such as Bash and Python for automating tasks.
• Good knowledge of some of Kotlin and/or Java.
• Experience with agile methodologies (Kanban/Scrum)
• Fluent in English
• Self-motived and able to work remotely and independently

Nice to have
• Linux administration
• Databases design and SQL
• Kotlin multiplatform and Jetpack compose.
• Experience in working in open source projects
• Interest on the use of technology for development and social change
• French and/or Spanish

Additional Information

PLEASE READ! Important instructions to ensure your application is considered

We value, above all else, applicants who are passionate about making a positive difference in the world. Please write 3 sentences in the “Message to Hiring Manager” portion of your application telling us why you are specifically interested in working with DHIS2. It doesn't have to be a lengthy cover letter, we just want to know that you have at least reviewed our website (dhis2.org) and want to join us in our mission.

Diversity and Inclusion

The people designing and building DHIS2 should reflect the people of every imaginable background, identity, gender, religion, ability, and nationality in more than 100 countries and on 6 continents worldwide who rely on it. We have published a diversity pledge where you can learn more about our commitment to continually improve the diversity of our teams and to combat unjust disadvantages prevalent throughout the technology industry.

We encourage people from diverse backgrounds to apply for our roles. This includes women, non-binary people, ethnic minorities, people with disabilities, LGBTQ+ people, people from the Global South, and anyone else who identifies with a group that remains underrepresented in tech and engineering. Please reach out if you have doubts about your suitability for a role, and let us know if you require any reasonable adjustments during any part of the application process.

Learn more at https://dhis2.org/careers/software/diversity

Location and Time Zones

You can work remotely from any country in the world or from our office in Oslo, Norway. If working remotely, we strongly prefer candidates who can have at least 4 hours of overlap with Central European Time Zone working hours. If you are located more than 2 time zones away from Europe, please indicate in your application how you will accommodate this difference. If you are located many timezones away and do not including any additional information in your application it may be automatically rejected.

Remote Work and Travel

We are a remote-first global team but we recognize the importance of meeting and collaborating with colleagues in person. You will have the opportunity to travel 1-3 times per year to meet with other members or your team. We host one annual all-hands meeting with the entire global software team, and each product team may also meet to collaborate or see DHIS2 use in the field. There may be additional opportunities to travel for conferences or to help facilitate academies. All travel expenses are fully covered.

We recognize that travel has an environmental impact, and so we work to limit travel to only what is essential and to mitigate or offset the impact of necessary travel we fund. We encourage the use of trains and other low-carbon transportation whenever this is a reasonable option.

Contract details

This is a full-time position (80% possible) on an annual renewable contract. We are focused on building long-term contractor relationships. We support flexible work arrangements with generous holiday allowances, and we offer the option to renew for longer contract periods over time

jobs_results.title: QA Analyst
jobs_results.description:
Job Description:

DXC Technology is a leading independent provider of IT services worldwide, helping its customers harness the power of innovation as a catalyst for success. We have nearly 6,000 customers in both the private and public sectors in 70 countries. Our technological independence, global expertise and extensive partner network combine to deliver next-generation IT services and solutions. DXC Spain is increasingly becoming the trusted IT provider for the most important companies throughout the country.

In DXC Spain we are looking for a QA Analyst to join and lead one of our teams. This is a new global testing service for a major client in the financial sector that provides DXC as a sole partner.

What are we looking for?
• People eager to participate in a functional testing team of customer applications.
• Knowledge and experience in the banking sector, in the Transactional Banking, Corporate Banking, Risk, Digital, etc. business areas.
• Experience in functional testing of... applications supported by different technologies: mainframe, middleware and/or web or digital environments.
• Experience in analyzing and interpreting project requirements from functional analysis or user story.
• Experience in the design of test scenarios and test cases according to the defined requirements. Knowledge and experience in some of the testing tools and frameworks, such as; HPQC, ALM or similar.
• Experience in identifying issues, reporting and following up with development teams. Knowledge in cross-functional management tools such as Jira,
• Experience in reporting results and participating in follow-ups and committees. Good communication with the client
• Good oral and written communication skills
• Some certification in the area of testing such as ISTQB will be an asset
• Language: English medium-high level (minimum B2)

What will your day-to-day work be like?
• You will work in a multidisciplinary team integrated in an international and multicultural environment.
• You will participate in the presentation of development projects (Project Kickoff).
• You will analyze project requirements
• You will define the testing strategy and processes
• Create the test plan and implement it in tools
• Validate both test preparation and test results, applying the input and output criteria for each test phase and preparing the project closeout report
• Identify and document defects and issues
• Ensure process compliance, identifying gaps and opportunities for process improvement
• Participate in meetings with the development teams

What will you find at DXC?
• An attractive salary depending on the experience provided.
• Ongoing training by the company in multiple technologies, especially cloud!
• Flexibility and work-life balance. Smart work if needed.
• The best work environment , not said by us but our employees on our satisfaction surveys.
• Visibility: we will encourage the attendance and organization of events, meetups and seminars.
• Flexible Payment Plan: restaurant ticket, kindergarten ticket, transportation ticket… Choose the one(s) that suit you most

jobs_results.title: Cloud QA Engineer (AWS/ Azure)
jobs_results.description:
Position Type :
Full time

Type Of Hire :
Experienced (relevant combo of work and education)

Education Desired :
Bachelor of Business Administration

Travel Percentage :
15 - 25%

Are you curious, motivated, and forward-thinking? At FIS you’ll have the opportunity to work on some of the most challenging and relevant issues in financial services and technology. Our talented people empower us, and we believe in being part of a team that is open, collaborative, entrepreneurial, passionate and above all fun.

About the team

Designs, develops and manages activities for FIS Balance Sheet Manager solution from product definition and planning through production, release, and end of life cycle.

We foster a friendly atmosphere in the team, which is filled with intelligent and experienced people who are ready to share their knowledge. An open communication is an important part of our team, and we recognize and accept all new ideas and insights.

What you will be doing

We are looking for a... talented Public Cloud Quality Assurance Engineer to help fast-forward our mission-critical risk management solutions into a cloud-based SaaS and Managed Services model. The ideal candidate will be a strongly result-oriented software tester working with FIS internal hosting organizations, public cloud providers, our development teams, clients, prospects, and many more to help shape and drive the roadmap for our strategic cloud initiative. This role is technically very broad and requires the flexibility to react to a very fast changing environment.
• Be a driver in our journey from on-prem, to lift and shift public cloud hosting, to full SaaS application:
• Specialize in how our software applications function in hosted environments, and our customer computing and IT use cases.
• Test public cloud-based risk management solutions with focus on performance and cloud scalability. Engage closely with our Development, Managed Services and various IT organizations, internally, externally and client-facing
• Drive, monitor and unblock obstacles in the development and execution of an “out of the box” public cloud hosting solution based on our distributed .NET/Windows stacks.
• Continually Identify, prioritize, and push for software changes and automation of blueprint patterns that ease repeated processes (e.g., client onboardings, releases, patches, upgrades, …)
• Continually evaluate and suggest new ideas that improve our cloud readiness, cost-efficiency, automation, or maintenance aspects (e.g., build & deployment, monitoring & alerting, …)
• Contribute in our agile software development process from the business requirement phase until testing and documentation phase
• Define and execute testing strategy based on a solid understanding of the client requirements
• Support the development team and successfully manage corresponding business processes
• This role requires coordination with and on-boarding of (where needed) some external, third party service partners who help FIS enhance its cloud offering for its clients.

What you bring
• Basic understanding of Banking and Capital market products- like loans, mortgages, credit cards, deposits, bonds- along with risk management is important to have.
• Understanding of cloud technologies- especially those from Azure and AWS is important to have e.g., RDS, PaaS, Terraform, Kubernetes, WVD, Workspaces, multi-tenant vs single tenant etc.
• Understanding of how financial applications in a B2B environment are deployed/implemented or upgraded.
• Experience in software quality assurance and software performance testing.
• Understanding of 3-tier architecture of financial applications
• Understanding of cloud architecture

Behavioral Skills
• Proactive: This role requires a self-starter, someone with an ability to coordinate and work with various internal and external teams from across Product, Implementation and Managed services, Sales and client.
• Problem mover: Requires the ability to gather information from various teams, understand the core problem and then engage the necessary FIS team to resolve it or move it towards a logical conclusion.
• Driven and Initiative taker: Requires the intent and motivation to drive discussions among various teams to identify potential issues or issues which exist but are not being actively discussed and which may come up in FIS cloud offerings and take proactive initiative to try to resolve them or move them towards their logical conclusion.
• Attitude: attitude to learn and understand FIS BSM clients and their business problems that FIS Managed cloud offering intends to solve

What we offer you

A career at FIS is more than just a job. It’s the change to shape the future of fintech. At FIS, we offer you:
• • A voice in the future of fintech
• • Always-on learning and development
• • Collaborative work environment
• • Opportunities to give back
• • Competitive salary and benefit

#LI-FD1

Privacy Statement

FIS is committed to protecting the privacy and security of all personal information that we process in order to provide services to our clients. For specific information on how FIS protects personal information online, please see the Online Privacy Notice.

Sourcing Model

Recruitment at FIS works primarily on a direct sourcing model; a relatively small portion of our hiring is through recruitment agencies. FIS does not accept resumes from recruitment agencies which are not on the preferred supplier list and is not responsible for any related fees for resumes submitted to job postings, our employees, or any other part of our company.

#pridepass

jobs_results.title: Senior QA Engineer (gn)
jobs_results.description:
Why SoftwareOne?

The SoftwareOne Marketplace Platform Team is seeking Senior QA Automation Engineers who enjoy working with the latest technologies and practices and are inspired to learn new things in new ways. You will be part of a 60 strong engineering team that prides itself on understanding the business that we support and evolve. Our approach to platform engineering aims to build SoftwareOne’s online marketplace, client interfaces, internal integrations and external vendor relations to a world class standard. Our philosophies include establishing a blame-free environment focused on continuous improvement. We strive to live a feedback culture that keeps an open mind to new ideas and productively challenges the ones we do not understand.

Being part of SoftwareOne means we live and breathe our company’s core values, most of all “Customer Focus” and “Speed”. But being part of the Marketplace Platoform team is a little more than that. Every single day we ask ourselves and our team... members to:
• Be curious, try things out! If you fail, that’s ok – we don’t blame
• Embrace change and start with “why not?” instead of “why?”
• Prioritize good over perfect – don’t withhold customers from functionality
• Leave the ego and office politics at the door
• Take ownership
• ….. and have fun

The role

100% Remote role from UK, Ireland, Spain, Poland

As a QA Automation Engineer you will be part of the QA Department in the SoftwareOne Marketplace Platform team. Albeit being an independent team, Engineers of the QA
Department are working very closely together with Development teams and collaborate with other organizational units on constant basis, such as Product Management, Technical Support and Customer Success. The QA Department’s mission is to ensure that the Marketplace Platform team delivers quality as perceived by our clients. Thus, you will play a vital role in ensuring that “quality” is on everyone’s radar - delivering a high quality product is a responsibility shared by everyone on the Marketplace platform team. Owning and performing a wide range of test types throughout all stages of the development process is at the core of your work. However, QA Engineers are also directly involved in creating and implementing quality-related standards and frameworks, providing transparency of our clients' current quality perception as well as reporting against the quality status of our platform at any point in time.

What will you do?
• Analyze and understand business and product requirements and ensure the engineering implementation covers all of them.
• Design and develop testing frameworks, test tools, and automation for complex, distributed systems.
• Define and set quality assurance metrics and thresholds, and ensure that they are met at any point of the development cycle.
• Holistic, end-to-end ownership for (automated) functional and non-functional testing, from creation of testing strategy and plan, to test data management, to execution and reporting of results.
• Define, implement, and analyze additional metrics and reports to determine test effectiveness, the overall quality of software as well as the clients’ perception of it.

What we need to see from you

Proven experience in the role of Quality Assurance / Test Engineer.
• Experience in the areas of B2B software and Cloud subscription reselling, B2B e-commerce, business process automation or similar is a plus.
• Experience in testing web based internal and external facing products (ideally in the
context of business automation platforms) from a functional as well as non-functional testing, for both front-end and back-end components.
• Experience using Azure/AWS services.
• Extensive front-end and / or back-end programming experience on C#, JavaScript, and / or TypeScript.
• Software (automation) development using OO design patterns.
• Hands-on experience in testing REST services.
• Experience with relational (MS SQL Server) and document database (MongoDB).
• Experience with automation test creation and maintenance using Playwright, Jest, Selenium, xUnit, NSubstitute, FluentAssertions, Autofixture C#.
• Experience with web performance testing, and load testing, database / SQL testing.
• Experience with GIT and code review process.

#LI-LP1

Job Function

Marketplace Platform

jobs_results.description:
To join Deloitte is to participate in the transformation of major national and international organizations. At Deloitte we are committed to making an impact on society our clients and you.

Join us?

Responsibilities:

• Translate business requirements and processes into technical requirement and configuration settings specific to software application solutions

• Design, build, and innovate a detailed automation framework and methodology for testing end to end

• Maintain an automation framework with a centralized test case repository in CI

• Supporting and independently completing test orchestration across the SDLC which will require problem solving using analysis, experience, and decision making

• Independently own a workstream, reviewing and testing related activities throughout the full life cycle of the project

• Responsible for recording, logging and tracking defects in the system and coordinate resolution with development team and functional leads

• Create and maintain... technical documentation covering areas you oversee"

Required Skills:

• +1 years of Automation Testing experience with automation tools such as Selenium, TestNG, UI testing, Webservices Testing

• Must have Java, .NET or Python development experience

• Experience in end- to- end test automation for Backend, UI and Web Applications

• Must have experience using 2 of the following 3 automation tools: Selenium, Cucumber or UFT

• Experience with testing plans, documentation, process, and testing execution on multiple development deliverables

• Clearly demonstrate knowledge in using various testing methodologies Agile and Scrum and logging results using solutions such as JIRA and or Confluence

• Experience with systems and integration testing

• Ability to work independently with little to no daily supervision

• Mentor and direct junior staff as needed"

You’ll really get our attention with:

• Experience using RPA to automate software processes end to end

• Experience with CI/CD build tools like Jenkins or Spinnaker

• Collaborating with the developers and with other teams around the globe"

Travel availability:

- Up to 10% travel in the testing and delivery phase

- Up to 3 months at the Host City during Games operations"

What do we offer you?
• You will have a flexible-hybrid working model
